body: Spec approved, built through mitosis, gated by hand, shipped as five pull requests.U+000AU+000AU+002A*mitosis run** (plan 42ec7ec5332d): 12 of 13 Steps ok, 73 of 73 acceptance tests pass (failed with the work reverted, passed with it), 0 inert. remove-entry-card correctly refused: `lib/features/day_detail/day_detail.dart` exports the tile it had to delete and was missing from its write-set. A resume cannot take a changed Step (the plan id changes), so the removal was done by hand.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Four defects the workers flagged outside their write-sets, all fixed with a test that failed first:**U+000A1U+002E Tapping a short note's text never opened it: the reader's `SelectionArea` (note_document.dart:95) took the tap, and two workers had written their tap tests against the time stamp instead. Fixed with an IgnorePointer around the short-note body in the compact card.U+000A2U+002E The viewer hardcoded its audio and video player factories, so the video tests moved from Today had lost their player-count, loaded-file and surface assertions. The viewer now reads `todayAudioPlayerFactoryProvider` and `todayVideoPlayerFactoryProvider`; every original assertion is restored.U+000A3U+002E The missing-audio placeholder had a fixed 64pt height and overflowed at doubled text; the loading waveform also overflowed any card narrower than about 250pt. The height is now a minimum and the waveform clips, as the design's `overflow:hidden` does. The narrow day-modal test regained the voice card it had dropped.U+000A4U+002E On the modal branch alone, two day-modal tests still expected the replaced composer titles; retargeted so each PR is green by itself.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Found during the removal:** `integration_test/note_perf_bench_test.dart` benchmark 5 asserted Today showed the old card, which the reversal had already broken invisibly (the local gate never runs integration tests). Retargeted to compact cards on the screens branch; its row in `docs/specs/research/2026-09-20-android-measurement.md` now says an earlier result is not comparable. Numbers 1 and 2, which decide u10, are untouched.U+000AU+000AU+002A*A mistake, corrected:** I used `git stash` in the modal worktree to compare against the old viewer. A stash is repository-wide, so it landed on the owner's stash list. It was popped immediately, the owner's older stashes untouched; comparisons since were done by writing files from `git show`.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Local gate per branch:** cards 1964 tests, modal 1988, calendar 1953, screens 2007, cleanup 1965; analyze clean and 39 goldens on each. Screens' final commit, the benchmark retarget, touched only an integration test and a doc, with analyze re-run clean after it.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Pull requests:** #164 cards (base main), #165 modal (on #164), #166 calendar (base main), #167 screens (on #165, since modal already contains cards), #168 cleanup (on #167).
